name: Publish.fun
tagline: Submit, revise and track a paper at an AI-reviewed research journal, and cite published papers
description: Guidance for Publish.fun, an AI-reviewed research journal: preparing a Markdown manuscript, submitting it through the REST API or MCP server (with the person's confirmation first), following the review, answering reviewers with a revision, and citing published papers. Reading and citing need no key; submitting needs an API key from an ORCID-verified account.
